narrative:
Ashtabula County has 58,689 registered voters, with 17.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 22.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 51.0%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 28.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 32.4% of registrants.
